title: PUBG PC India Esports Gets ₹25 Lakh PUBG India Cup 2026
description: PUBG PC India esports is stirring as KRAFTON announces the PUBG India Cup 2026 with a ₹25 lakh prize pool, and a dedicated region is rumoured for 2027.

body.text: PUBG PC India esports may finally be getting its moment. According to sportsdigest.in, KRAFTON India Esports has teased a new chapter for the PC version of the game and announced its first India-focused tournament, the PUBG India Cup 2026, with a ₹25 lakh prize pool. It matters because PC players have long had far fewer official competitive options than their BGMI counterparts.
Why PUBG PC India has trailed BGMI in esports
Mobile has dominated the Indian battle royale scene. BGMI became the main focus for players, teams, fans and organisers, backed by regular big events such as BGIS, BMPS and BMIC.

PUBG PC took a different road. Sportsdigest.in notes that PUBG was banned in India in 2020, but that ban did not apply to the PC version. Even so, the game never built a competitive ecosystem anywhere near the size of BGMI's.
Community contests and small events kept the scene alive. What it lacked was a dedicated regional circuit, which makes it harder for Indian players to build an international presence.
The teaser and the PUBG India Cup 2026

The buzz began on October 20, 2026, when KRAFTON India Esports posted a teaser on its official social media account. It carried KRAFTON and PUBG Esports branding and the caption: "A new chapter for PC esports in India is loading… Stay tuned."

The timing raised eyebrows because KRAFTON's 2026 Indian esports roadmap, per the report, focused mainly on BGMI, with its top tournaments built around mobile. The teaser led to speculation that the company might expand beyond mobile.
That speculation soon turned into a concrete announcement. Here is what we know about the PUBG India Cup (PIC) 2026:

items: Open-for-all competition exclusively for Indian PUBG PC players
Players must be at least 18 years old
Players must live in India and play their matches from within the country

body.text: Could India get its own PUBG PC region in 2027?

The bigger question is what comes after. Sportsdigest.in points to reports from Letsgrowesports that plans are being made for a dedicated Indian region in 2027. KRAFTON has not confirmed this, so treat it as unconfirmed for now.

If it does happen, Indian teams could get an organised route into international PUBG PC competitions. Right now they have to go through the PUBG Master Series, facing teams from regions such as Taiwan, Hong Kong and Japan. That makes qualifying tougher, especially for squads still building international experience.

Keep an eye on KRAFTON India Esports' official channels for details on the PUBG India Cup 2026, including how it is structured and when it runs. Also watch for any official word on a dedicated Indian region. A single tournament is a start, but a lasting regional circuit is what would really change things for PC players in India.

faqs.q: What is the PUBG India Cup 2026?
faqs.a: According to sportsdigest.in, it is a PUBG PC tournament announced by KRAFTON India Esports with a prize pool of ₹25 lakh. It is open to Indian PUBG PC players only.

faqs.q: Who can play in the PUBG India Cup 2026?
faqs.a: Players must be at least 18 years old, live in India and play their matches from within the country, as per sportsdigest.in.

faqs.q: Will India get its own PUBG PC esports region in 2027?
faqs.a: It is not confirmed. KRAFTON has not announced anything, but sportsdigest.in cites reports from Letsgrowesports that plans for a dedicated Indian region are being made.
